definitions: To speak to (a person or an audience), especially formally.
To write the name and address of the recipient on (an envelope, letter, or parcel).
To think about and begin to deal with (an issue or problem).
To direct (something) at someone or something.
To use a title when speaking or writing to someone.
examples: He addressed the crowd for over an hour.
Please address the letter to the Royal Mail.
We need to address the issue of climate change.
The new policy addresses the needs of the community.
